title: Mesh
description: Visualize and manage the mesh: Reticulum and XPRS.
summary: An interactive map of the mesh as this node has observed it: Reticulum nodes, hubs and the links between them, and the XPRS stations heard over the air (Bluetooth, LAN, LoRa) with their signal, uptime and carried mail. Filters for the services a node provides and a highlight for peers running XPRS software. Manage the bootstrap hubs on the public internet and toggle relay (passive) mode. The view is observed-only — a sampled subset of the announces and beacons this node heard, never a hub's full client roster.
